correctness.rationale: The Simson/pedal quadratic identity gives Q=(R^2-|P-O|^2)/(4R^2) with supporting side lines; every triangle interior point lies in its circumdisk. For barycentric Dirichlet(1,1,1), Q=[a_1 lambda_2 lambda_3 + a_2 lambda_3 lambda_1 + a_3 lambda_1 lambda_2]/4. Exact Dirichlet integrals yield mu=e1/48 and nu=(e1^2-e2)/1440. Heron and s1 s2 s3=4 Delta R yield e3=4e2-e1^2, so Vieta uniquely reconstructs squared side ratios from the two moments, including obtuse and repeated-root cases. The isosceles pair (7/2,7/2,7/4) and (5/2,5/2,15/4) has identical first moment and different e2. Independently checked the right triangle (0,0),(4,0),(0,3): a=(4,36/25,64/25), mu=1/6 and nu=577/18750 with the Heron identity verified exactly. Finite examples do not replace the universal symmetric-polynomial proof.
